scope: Prototype screening rules for retail pre-packaged commodities
notes: These rules are a prototype configuration for AI-assisted screening, not a complete codification of Legal Metrology law.
The engine reports potential non-compliance and requires human verification before legal or enforcement action.
Applicability is intentionally conservative where package context is uncertain.

rules.requirement: Name and address of the manufacturer, packer or importer must be declared for retail packages.
rules.source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6; Department of Consumer Affairs advisory dated 18-01-2023

rules.requirement: The common or generic name of the commodity contained in the package must be declared.
Net quantity must be declared in terms of the applicable standard unit of weight, measure or number.
Month and year of manufacture, packing or import must be declared as applicable.
Best before/use by information must be declared for commodities which may become unfit for human consumption.
Retail sale price must be declared in the form of Maximum Retail Price (MRP), inclusive of all taxes.
Consumer care details must be declared.
Country of origin must be declared for imported products.
Unit sale price must be declared in the prescribed form for applicable pre-packaged commodities; exceptions require contextual verification.
rules.source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6(11), as amended

rules.requirement: Declarations required on the package must be legible and prominent.
